# VoiceShield AI

> VoiceShield is a zero-trust AI spoof voice detection and social engineering defense platform.

VoiceShield is designed to protect individuals, contact centers, and financial organizations against synthetic speech deepfakes, unauthorized voice cloning, and AI-driven extortion attacks. It combines Wav2Vec2-XLSR cross-lingual acoustic sequence classification with real-time contextual threat synthesis.

## Core Capabilities
- **Neural Spoof Detection**: Pretrained Wav2Vec2 sequence classifier trained on authentic vs. vocoded speech artifacts.
- **Contextual Threat Engine**: Synthesizes acoustic phonetic anomaly scores with behavioral extortion indicators (unverified caller IDs, artificial urgency, payment demands).
- **16kHz Ingestion Pipeline**: Native browser 16,000 Hz WAV recording and lossless audio file analysis (WAV, MP3, FLAC).
- **Zero-Trust Audit Vault**: Cryptographically signed audit logging with Supabase PostgreSQL and offline SQLite fallback.
